units.text: Sing, clear-voiced Muse, of Hephaestus famed for
inventions. With bright-eyed Athena he taught men glorious
crafts throughout the world, —men who before used to dwell
in caves in the mountains like wild beasts.
But now that they have learned crafts through Hephaestus
the famed worker, easily they live a
peaceful life in their own houses the
whole year round. Be gracious, Hephaestus, and grant me success and prosperity!
